constantDepthPolicy.worldLaw: P(D)=P(source-depth0.6)+(D-0.6)*cameraOut. One D for whole composition, all poses/facings.
constantDepthPolicy.localLaw: With unchanged1.25 root scale and35deg camera: location.x=-sin(facing)*(D*cos35/1.25), location.y=-cos(facing)*(D*cos35/1.25), location.z=D*sin35/1.25; yaw remains-facing, rotation.x remains55deg.
constantDepthPolicy.cornerInterpretation: Compare any D to the single derived canonical quad at sourceD0.6. Do not demand equality to old cropped-source top corners; source/canonical image aspect and UV window differ.
